title: Decode both European compact-cell frame encodings
platforms: European ROM and Windows interpreter under Wine
changes: Decode the four value-14 records as byte runs with even payload alignment. Use the same bounded frame parser for the 87 halfword records and preserve the packed e311-d310 file.
Expose frame geometry, placement bytes, encoded extents and row-major cell values from complete compact-record spans. Validate their directory bounds during extraction.
validation: Wine disassembly u6btxs9v authenticates the original draw dispatcher and byte reader. The Windows GNU test build t6q8o82v and the focused Wine test vgbeflbq pass.
Controlled original draws match 483 halfword and ten byte frames with transparency marker zero. The 31,634-byte extraction reproduces E491 SHA-256. All 20 protected paths pass and Wine drains.
limitations: Ordinary background setup, live selectors, alias attribution and translated dispatch remain open. Linux, USA, native Windows and performance work are deferred.
The client did not independently confirm the primary Terra xhigh setting.
